title: A Collective owns member Spaces: 5 included, more at the extra-Space price, each with Business tools
detail:
PHASE 8 of the five-tier ladder (ADR-1709). App code over spaces.parent_id (the column exists, no code reads it): attach and detach member Spaces, count against 5 included plus collective_space items, member Spaces resolve to Business depth. canCreateSpace follows the owner default (1 free Space per member; owning Business or Collective lets them start more). Required before Founding Collective sells.

Owner-gated attach/detach RPCs enforce five included plus live extra-Space items without changing stored child plans. Active Collective membership grants Business depth across tools, meters, seats and fees; cancellation or detach restores own-plan behavior. Billing offers exact-price same-interval Stripe extra-Space quantity changes with attachment floors and serialized reservations. Actual migration SQL passed 30 database assertions; focused behavior/UI tests and full typecheck passed. Production migration and available catalog prices remain deployment prerequisites.
